listing.name: inFAMOUS Second Son (iss_pc)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for iss_pc; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports early chapters, 20-30 FPS typical on RTX2060 and graphics glitches. Complete campaign and broad GPU coverage unproven. Upstream early chapters, 20-30FPS RTX2060, known graphics errors; AMD RX580 experimental crashes and F16C adaptation. Linux/Windows packages not full campaign proof. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux x86-64 PS4/Vulkan runtime. RX580 compatibility experimental; older CPU F16C workarounds documented. Original data: PS4 inFAMOUS Second Son CUSA00223 base1.00+update1.07 own dump. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
